1. (Currently amended) A system for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: a computing device including a processor coupled to a system memory, the system memory storing instructions for execution on the processor, the instructions configured to cause the processor to: retrieve [[a]] __network activity__ data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain; analyze the network activity data and identify a malicious network threat; and perform a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat, __wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to normalize the network activity data to a standard format, decorate the network activity data with at least one tag that identifies the network activity data, store the network activity data in a database, weight the network activity data according to a threat associated with the data, and generate a risk score for the weighted data.__

5. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the instructions are further configured to cause the processor to push a notification including the mitigating action for the malicious network threat to a third party device.

10. (Currently amended) A method for identifying malicious threats on a network comprising: retrieving [[a]] __network activity__ data associated with at least one of an IP address or a domain; analyzing the network activity data and identify a malicious network threat; and performing a mitigating action to neutralize the malicious network threat, __wherein the method further comprises: normalizing the network activity data to a standard format; decorating the network activity data with at least one tag that identifies the network activity data; storing the network activity data in a database; weighing the network activity data according to a threat associated with the data; and generating a risk score for the weighted data.__

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 10, further comprising pushing a notification including the mitigating action for the malicious network threat to a third party device.
